verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every open PR across all connected repositories and applies organization-level settings across all repos at once (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-10), and Rule Miner mines standards from PR history in bulk (qodo-docs-13), showing some cross-item automation. However there's no explicit evidence of a user-triggered bulk action (e.g., mass-approve, bulk-fix across many findings/PRs simultaneously) beyond the automatic per-PR review pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-trigger UI/API for acting on many PRs or findings at once, and independent confirmation of scale/performance across large item sets.
